A second-factor token cannot be used as an access token
Health reports ok when the database is up
Merchant login returns a token with the expected claims
Login with a wrong password is rejected
Login with an unknown email is rejected
Admin login requires a second factor

A duplicate merchant email is a conflict
Merchant creation rejects invalid input: empty-name
Merchant creation rejects invalid input: bad-email
Merchant creation rejects invalid input: short-password
Deleting a merchant cascades and revokes access
Idempotency
The same key and body return the same payment
The same key with a different body is a conflict
A missing idempotency key is rejected
A changed currency counts as a different body
A changed description counts as a different body
A changed card_token counts as a different body
A replay returns the payment's current state
Idempotency keys are scoped per merchant
A replay creates no second database row
Basic access checks
An expired token is rejected
The payment list never shows other merchants' payments
A merchant cannot read another merchant's payment
A merchant cannot use admin endpoints
A request without a token is unauthorized
An admin token cannot use merchant endpoints
Admin endpoints require a token
A malformed token is unauthorized: garbage
A malformed token is unauthorized: malformed
A token signed with another secret is rejected
A merchant cannot authorize another merchant's payment
A merchant cannot capture another merchant's payment
A merchant cannot void another merchant's payment
A merchant cannot refund another merchant's payment

Payment creation rejects an invalid body: missing-currency

The list filters by status
The list filters by created date range

The list rejects an invalid query: limit-too-big
The list rejects an invalid query: negative-offset

Refunds
A refund amount must be positive: 0
A refund amount must be positive: -1
Refund rows match the payment's refunded total
A refund over the payment amount is rejected
Partial refunds accumulate until the payment is fully refunded
A full refund in one call marks the payment refunded
A refund exceeding the remainder is rejected

A forbidden transition is rejected and changes nothing: partially_refunded--capture
Allowed transition: created--authorize-->authorized
A forbidden transition is rejected and changes nothing: partially_refunded--void
Allowed transition: authorized--capture-->captured

A forbidden transition is rejected and changes nothing: refunded--authorize
Allowed transition: authorized--void-->voided

A forbidden transition is rejected and changes nothing: refunded--capture
A forbidden transition is rejected and changes nothing: created--refund

A forbidden transition is rejected and changes nothing: authorized--authorize

A forbidden transition is rejected and changes nothing: authorized--refund
A forbidden transition is rejected and changes nothing: failed--refund

A forbidden transition is rejected and changes nothing: voided--authorize

A forbidden transition is rejected and changes nothing: captured--capture
A forbidden transition is rejected and changes nothing: voided--capture
A forbidden transition is rejected and changes nothing: captured--void
A forbidden transition is rejected and changes nothing: voided--void

Domain events
A partial refund publishes payment.refunded with the refunded amount
A declined authorization publishes payment.failed
Rejected requests publish nothing: illegal transition and over-refund
The event, the response header and the log line share one request id
Capturing a payment publishes one payment.captured with the payment's data
Database consistency
No idempotency key maps to two payments
Refunds never add up to more than the payment amount
Payment status agrees with the sum of its refunds
Refund rows match the amounts the API reports
Totals per status equal what the API lists
Deleting a merchant leaves no payments, refunds or keys
Provider integration
A slow provider within the timeout still succeeds
An approved charge authorizes the payment
A provider failure ends in failed with a reason: decline
A provider failure ends in failed with a reason: http-500
A provider failure ends in failed with a reason: timeout
Retrying a failed payment does not charge again: tok_decline
Retrying a failed payment does not charge again: tok_error
Retrying a failed payment does not charge again: tok_timeout
Request log
A refund over the remainder is logged as rejected with the refundable amount
No password, token, one-time code or card token appears in the log
An unusable X-Request-ID is replaced by a generated one: has spaces in it
An unusable X-Request-ID is replaced by a generated one: xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
An unusable X-Request-ID is replaced by a generated one: quote"{"event":"forged"}
An unauthenticated request is logged without a merchant
A refund logs its events in order, all under the request's id
A rejected transition is logged as a rejection and changes no status
The access line of a request carries the response's request id and the merchant
A valid X-Request-ID from the caller is kept and used in the log
An unusable X-Request-ID is replaced by a generated one: short
